name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tabs with a cobalt location band that stretches; optional count voice; panels.
whenToUse: Use it to switch between views of one place. For an app's sections use Nav; for a compact choice of a value use Segmented.

parts.name: TabsList
parts.description: The tab row (Base UI Tabs.List), with the band beneath its tabs.

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own frame. cell: inside an enclosing frame (no own border, no cut).

parts.name: TabsRoot
parts.description: Tabs: location. Keyboard, roving focus, aria and panels come from Base UI Tabs; activation follows focus by default, as in a view switcher. Works with or without panels (e.g. table views).

parts.name: TabsTab
parts.description: A tab (Base UI Tabs.Tab). `count` adds the count voice under the label.

props.name: count
props.description: The count voice under the label (e.g. records in a view).
